headline: Tapestry Collection by Hilton Debuts in Vietnam with Opening of NHAAN Resort & Spa Hoi An
summary: Hilton (NYSE: HLT) has opened NHAAN Resort & Spa Hoi An, Tapestry Collection by Hilton, a tranquil riverside sanctuary in Central Vietnam's UNESCO World Heritage-listed port town, which is famed for its cobbled streets and winding waterways. The property marks the debut of Tapestry Collection by Hilton in Vietnam, introducing this brand collection of original, independent hotels to one of the country's most culturally rich destinations.
